psflib, the PSF container reader (zlib-compressed exe, tags, _lib chains) by Christopher Snowhill (kode54). Licence: MIT (COPYING).
Upstream: https://github.com/kode54/psflib, commit 95509e0c6f13d769593bbf51a1b0e0efdc355ba1 (2025-04-05). Vendored: psflib.c, psflib.h.
Not vendored: psf2fs.c/h (PSF2 file system; QSF does not use it). Needs zlib at build time (system zlib on the host).
